name: DDECK PWA
description: Adds a Bootstrap PWA navigation bar (SDC), iOS home-screen meta tags, Apple splash-screen links and theme-based manifest icons on top of the contrib PWA module.
project_description: DDECK PWA is a thin UI and iOS enhancement layer that sits on top of the contrib PWA module. It renders a fixed-bottom, mobile-only Bootstrap navigation bar (back / forward / home / reload) as a Single Directory Component, injects Apple mobile-web-app meta tags and apple-touch-startup-image splash-screen links for a native-feeling iOS home-screen app, and replaces the PWA manifest icons with theme-provided icons when the active theme ships them under its pwa/ directory. It requires the PWA module (pwa:pwa) and core SDC, and its markup assumes Bootstrap 6 utility classes supplied by the theme. A small settings form lets an administrator set the iOS app title and toggle the navigation bar; the manifest, service worker and theme colors themselves remain managed by the PWA module.
